sloka: अयम् आत्म भवः शोको माम् अनाथम् अचेतनम् ।सम्सादयति वेगेन यथा कूलम् नदी रयः ॥२-६४-७५॥
transliteration: ayam ātma bhavaḥ śoko mām anātham acetanam ।samsādayati vegena yathā kūlam nadī rayaḥ ॥2-64-75॥

translations.english: This selfcreated grief is rapidly destroying me like the bank of a river eroded by its swift current, leaving me helpless and insensible.
